title: Recruitment to Various Posts at Vizhinjam International Seaport Limited (VISL)
age_limit: Maximum 30-45 years (post-specific) as on 2026-11-01, with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government rules.
summary: The Centre for Management Development (CMD) invites online applications on behalf of Vizhinjam International Seaport Limited (VISL) for 5 various positions on a contract basis. The application period is from November 25, 2026, to December 09, 2026. Selected candidates will be deployed to VISL for an initial period of one year.
eligibility_bullets: Applicants must be a citizen of India.
Educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from Diploma/B.Com to B.E./B.Tech with M.Tech/MBA/PGDM.
Post-qualification experience required ranges from 1 to 10 years, depending on the post.
Age limit is post-specific, with a maximum of 30, 35, 36, or 45 years as on November 01, 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST (5 years) and OBC (3 years) candidates as per Government rules.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: B.E./B.Tech Civil + M.Tech/MBA/PGDM, 3 years exp, Max 35 years, Rs. 42,500/-
B.Com + CA Inter, 10 years exp, Max 45 years, Rs. 40,000/-
B.Tech Civil (3 years exp) OR Diploma Civil (5 years exp), Max 45 years, Rs. 35,000/-
B.Com with Tally, 2 years exp, Max 36 years, Rs. 22,240/-
B.E./B.Tech Civil (1 year exp) OR Diploma Civil (3 years exp), Max 30 years, Rs. 27,500/-

how_to_apply_steps: Apply online through the Centre for Management Development (CMD) website (www.cmd.kerala.gov.in).
Ensure all terms and conditions of the recruitment are met before applying.
Scan and upload a recent photograph (less than 200KB, JPG format).
Scan and upload your signature (less than 50KB, JPG format); initials or capital letters are not permitted.
Compulsorily fill all relevant fields in the online application form.
Maintain a valid personal email ID and mobile number active until the recruitment process is complete for receiving intimations.
